definitions.explanation: The act of exchanging one currency for another, or exchanging bills for coins.

examples.japanese: {両替|りょうがえ}⟦{所|じょ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.notes: {両替|りょうがえ}⟦{所|じょ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧ = currency exchange office

examples.japanese: ⟦ドル→ドル：01554_doru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{両替|りょうがえ}⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to exchange dollars for yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{千円|せんえん}{札|さつ}→千円札：16603_senensatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{小銭|こぜに}→小銭：02759_kozeni⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{両替|りょうがえ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらえます→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Could you exchange this 1000-yen bill for coins?
examples.notes: Also used for breaking bills into smaller denominations

notes:
USAGE: {両替|りょうがえ} can refer to both (1) exchanging foreign currency and (2) breaking bills into coins or smaller bills.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{両替|りょうがえ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to exchange money)
・{両替|りょうがえ}⟦{所|じょ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧ (currency exchange office)
・⟦{両替|りょうがえ}{機|き}→両替機：10190_ryougaeki⟧ (change machine)
・{両替|りょうがえ}⟦レート→レート：11248_reeto⟧ (exchange rate)

RELATED:
・⟦{為替|かわせ}→為替：04021_kawase⟧ - exchange (financial term)
・⟦{外貨|がいか}→外貨：12152_gaika⟧ - foreign currency
・⟦{換金|かんきん}→換金：28179_kankin⟧ - conversion to cash
